name: Tanner Park
description: A Town of Babylon waterfront park on the Great South Bay. In summer the town runs a free evening concert series here with tribute and cover bands, and the park also hosts festivals such as a bluegrass festival and a pow wow.

dancing.notes: Concerts are outdoors, and the town tells people to bring lawn chairs or blankets, so most of the crowd sits. Some shows are billed as dance bands (for example an 80s dance band) and there is open grass, but we found no reports describing people dancing.

evidence.note: Town calendar lists a free 7 PM summer concert at Tanner Park in July 2026 and tells guests to bring lawn chairs or blankets.
